content:
We need to evaluate model on test set and cross-validation. Use evaluate_xgboost_model tool for test set evaluation (includes detailed analysis). For cross-validation, use perform_cross_validation on training data.

Paths:
model: /.../2_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_11/trained_xgboost_model.pkl
test data: .../2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_11/sulphide_ml_dataset/test.csv
train data: .../2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_11/sulphide_ml_dataset/train.csv

We need to get evaluation results: test_set_evaluation dict with mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance. The evaluate_xgboost_model returns many metrics; we need to extract those fields. The tool likely returns a JSON with metrics. We'll call evaluate_xgboost_model with detailed_analysis True.

Then perform_cross_validation with cv_folds 5, target column formation_energy_per_atom, hyperparameters maybe default.

The cross-validation result will include r2_mean and r2_std.

We then combine into a dict and write to JSON file at /Users/.../2_evaluate_model_performance_trial_11/model_evaluation_results.json

We need to write file using write_file.

First call evaluate_xgboost_model.
